g.text: A: Barrett et al. 2024 Fig 5D, values read from the published figure. B: CPTAC PDAC proteomics, median split, log-rank. C: Human Protein Atlas single-cell consensus, 154 cell types. Clinical verdicts are shown for context only and never enter the ranking.
